chem-pharm-01-c3.quote: Naloxone injection is used along with emergency medical treatment to reverse the life-threatening effects
chem-pharm-01-c3.claim: An antagonist binds a receptor without activating it, which blocks the natural agonist; naloxone reverses opioid overdoses this way.
